card.name: Ending of inhalation and similar words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split medical word, most often "ation" in "inhalation" before "aerosol" in HFA inhaler labels. It also fires on a few other word endings such as "ingestion", "kinetics", "grade" and "authorized".

modes.label: inhalation ending
modes.description: The "ation" piece completing "inhalation" in inhaler product names or phrases.
modes.example: ate HFA inhal<<ation>> aerosol can produce paradoxical bronch

modes.label: other word endings
modes.description: A word completing a drug or term phrase, such as ingestion, kinetics, grade or authorized.
modes.example: There is limited experience with overdosage. Acute ingestion of up to 20 g of ribavirin capsules, INTRON A<< ingestion>> of up to 120 million
